headlines.title: Premarket movers: Nvidia, Intel fall; J&J gains
headlines.summary: Investing.com - U.S. stock index futures were mixed on Monday, with Nasdaq 100 futures leading declines as investors looked ahead to Nvidia’s quarterly results for fresh clues about the strength of artificial intelligence demand. The cautious mood followed a week in which Wall Street posted gains despite a sharp selloff in the chipmaker’s shares, with uncertainty surrounding its leadership adding to concerns about the outlook for the AI trade.

headlines.title: Trump held up to $62m in Nvidia stock as of August - report
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- President Donald Trump held between $13 million and $62 million in Nvidia stock as of the end of August, the Washington Post reported on Monday, citing a review of his financial disclosures.

headlines.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang comeback unlikely, Lynx analyst says
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- The prospect of Jensen Huang returning to Nvidia is attracting attention after a Financial Times report described a campaign by influential Silicon Valley executives to bring the former CEO back. But Lynx Equity Strategies sees little chance of a reversal, arguing that the circumstances behind his departure make a comeback highly improbable.

headlines.title: Petition to restore Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO receives 170,000 signatures
headlines.summary: Tech billionaire has reportedly been plotting his return to the company he founded 33 years ago

headlines.title: Jensen Huang’s Net Worth Plunges $27 Billion
headlines.summary: Nvidia's leadership crisis has already burned through a fortune, but the costliest blow may not come from Wall Street or Washington. Billionaire history shows how one personal event can erase tens of billions in a single stroke.

description: NVIDIA Corporation operates as a data center scale AI infrastructure company in the United States, Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Compute & Networking, and Graphics segments. The Compute & Networking segment provides data center accelerated computing and networking platforms and artificial intelligence solutions and software, and automotive platforms and autonomous and electric vehicle solutions, including software. The Graphics segment offers GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs; Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics. The company's products are used in gaming, professional visualization, data center, and automotive markets. It sells its products to original equipment manufacturers, original device manufacturers, system integrators and distributors, independent software vendors, cloud service providers, add-in board manufacturers, distributors, automotive manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers, and other ecosystem participants. It has a collaboration with Cisco to develop Ultra-Dense Small Form Factor Pluggable (USFP), a high-density optical module pluggable transceiver. It has a collaboration with ChipAgents to develop Build-A-Chip-Bench, a benchmark for AI agents carrying chip design tasks and The Company has a strategic alliance with MediaTek to build the next generations of AI computing platforms. NVIDIA Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
